patches.name: Hide live chat clutter
patches.description: Hides the pinned message banner and poll cards in live chat, and fixes the chat input field being covered by the on-screen keyboard. Each can be toggled in Morphe settings (Ayufa patch settings) without re-patching. For YouTube 21.30.216.

options.title: Hide pinned message banner
options.description: Hides the pinned comment (banner) shown above the live chat.

options.title: Hide live chat polls
options.description: Hides poll (questionnaire) cards shown in the live chat.

options.title: Fix live chat keyboard overlap
options.description: Fixes the live chat input field being covered by the on-screen keyboard while typing.

patches.name: Live latency keeper
patches.description: At a fixed interval, momentarily pauses and resumes live stream playback so it snaps back to the live edge (the newest position), no matter how far behind it has fallen. The interval and the on/off switch can be changed in Morphe settings (Ayufa patch settings) without re-patching. For YouTube 20.26.46 (Android 8.0) and 21.30.216. Requires the official Morphe patches to be applied as well.

options.title: Default sync interval
options.description: How often live playback is snapped back to the newest position with a momentary pause and resume. Used until the interval is changed in Morphe settings (Ayufa patch settings).
